title: Non-cooperative intruder
description: An unregistered drone with no Remote ID flies from the Main Gate to SNCC through campus traffic. The DTC and ADMM cannot see it; other drones only detect it with onboard sensing inside 30 m and avoid it. The operator slows traffic in the central sector while it passes.
timeline: @intruder (no Remote ID) departs Main Gate → SNCC
Invisible to the DTC and ADMM; others sense it within 30 m
Operator speed limit 6 m/s in S1 for 60 s
